title: Rudra Constructions & Suppliers
description: From structural engineering to turnkey commissioning, we deliver certified Class-1 civil construction, hospital wards, solar microgrids, and bulk materials across 11 Indian states.

items.title: Panchayat Sarkar Bhawan Administrative Complex
items.content_text: Constructed standard-format, disaster-resilient Panchayat Sarkar Bhawan comprising public grievance halls, elected representative offices, digital citizen service centers, sanitized washrooms, and solar backup power.

items.title: Public Hospital Inpatient Ward Modernization
items.content_text: Complete structural renovation and retrofitting of a multi-bed hospital inpatient ward. Features medical-grade anti-static vinyl flooring, acoustic false ceiling with soothing blue LED illumination, ergonomic patient beds, and specialized sanitation zones.

items.title: Solar Rural Electrification & Street Lighting Mission
items.content_text: Executed widespread installation of autonomous high-lumen LED solar street light systems across rural villages, community squares, and primary health centers. Provides dusk-to-dawn safety, crime deterrence, and eco-friendly lighting.

items.title: Regional Highway Overpass & Segmental Infrastructure
items.content_text: Execution of reinforced concrete substructure and pier columns for critical bypass corridor. Utilizes computerized batching, high-tensile Fe 550D rebar cages, and self-compacting concrete to ensure long-term structural integrity under heavy axle traffic.

items.title: Fisheries & Animal Resource Technical Facility
items.content_text: Specialized institutional facility built for veterinary diagnosis, aquatic testing, and storage of animal resource supplies. Includes moisture-resistant wall treatments, dedicated drainage, cold room enclosures, and staff administrative quarters.

items.title: Bulk TMT Steel & Cement Logistics Consignment
items.content_text: Consolidated procurement and logistics dispatch of over 1,800 Metric Tonnes of primary steel and 45,000 bags of OPC 53 cement for watershed development structures, check dams, and rural housing clusters.
